title: MxAgile Verification Scenario
description: A material UI verification scenario derived from Requirement behavior, role differences, data scope, editability, screen differences, responsive behavior, and known risks. NOT a blind Cartesian product. See policies/verification-scenario.md for the derivation contract. File location: planning/scenarios/<scenario-id>.yaml

scenario_id.description: Stable identifier for this scenario, e.g. SCN-CUSTOMER-ADMIN-POPULATED.

screen_id.description: The page_id from the UI inventory this scenario verifies.

role.description: The Mendix role active during this scenario.

data_state.description: Required application data state. populated=representative mock data must be loaded. empty=no entity instances needed. partial=some but not full data. error=error/validation state triggered. any=data state is not material for this scenario.

viewport.description: Target viewport for this scenario, e.g. desktop-1440, phone-375, tablet-768. 'all' means all configured project viewports must pass.

verification_dimensions.description: Which parity dimensions this scenario covers. A scenario need not cover all 7 dimensions.

traceability.description: Links to the Requirements, Specs, and role behaviors this scenario verifies.

acceptance_clauses.description: Specific acceptance criteria clauses from Requirements/Specs.

prerequisites.description: Required state before this scenario can execute.

mock_data_required.description: When true, representative mock data must be loaded before this scenario.

mock_data_seed_identity.description: Non-secret identity key (from .env.mendix via env_key reference) used to seed mock data. May differ from the scenario verification identity. e.g. DEVELOPER_SEED_IDENTITY.

mock_data_script.description: Path to mock data seed script, relative to project root.

requires_authenticated_session.description: When true, a valid authenticated session for the declared role must be established before the scenario begins.

depends_on_scenarios.description: Scenario IDs that must complete successfully before this scenario can run (e.g., data setup scenario).

decomposition.description: Scenario size and parallelism safety contract.

bounded_responsibility.description: Human-readable statement of what this scenario is responsible for (one page/flow, one role, one data state).

parallelism_safe.description: True only when this scenario does not share mutable resources (session, database, test data, planning records) with other concurrently running scenarios. Default: false — assume serial unless explicitly proven safe.

parallelism_rationale.description: Required when parallelism_safe=true. Explains why this scenario is isolated from concurrent mutation.

timeout_policy.description: Scenario-specific timeout overrides. See policies/verification-scenario.md — Timeout Policy.

assertion_timeout_ms.description: Timeout for individual DOM assertions. Default from project config.

scenario_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time for the entire scenario to complete.

timeout_rationale.description: Required when any timeout exceeds the project default. Must not compensate for poor decomposition.

status.description: required=must be executed for Full UI Acceptance PASS. completed=executed and evidence recorded. partial=some dimensions done. blocked=cannot run (prerequisite missing). not_applicable=coverage not needed. superseded=replaced by another scenario.

blocking_reason.description: When status=blocked: non-secret description of what is preventing execution.

evidence_manifest_id.description: ID of the evidence manifest entry that records the artifacts produced by this scenario.

parity_result.description: Aggregated parity result for this scenario after last execution. STALE=was PASS but target/runtime has changed and re-verification is required.
